rules.rule: Fill every candidate window at the posted public mark. entry_edge=0.0.
rules.falsifier: Not a claim. Naming this is not evidence of edge.
rules.note: This is the loop's current behavior, dated so later selection rules cannot pretend the undeclared overnight was their OOS.

rules.rule: Skip the paper fill when posted_yes is strictly inside (0.45, 0.55). Otherwise fill at the posted mark with entry_edge=0.0.
rules.falsifier: After 40 eligible windows, if selected-fill settlement_pnl cannot be distinguished from R-BASELINE-FILL-ALL on those same windows, park this rule. Do not retune the band.
rules.note: Band chosen before looking at overnight marks. execution=false until paper.py honors rules.decide(). OOS still accumulates from declared_at by replay; replayed results are not lived results.
